objective: Evidence-constrained activity-suggestion policy learned from real randomized intervention outcomes
population: available decision points during the planned first 210 decisions for each participant
outcome: log1p of Jawbone steps in the 30 minutes after the decision; public release's documented zero-imputed field
features: pre-decision Jawbone steps in 30 and 60 minutes
pre-decision Google Fit steps in 30 and 60 minutes
recent suggestion dosage from earlier decisions only

evaluation.inner: 3-fold GroupKFold by source participant for threshold selection
evaluation.estimator: cross-fitted doubly robust policy value with known 0.6/0.4 randomization probabilities
evaluation.official_outcome_reuse: outer participant outcomes are used once for frozen evaluation and never for threshold selection
